about: Names the detectors must not misread. Each list says why it exists; a name added here silences a detector for it everywhere, so add only what a platform or a framework provides on its own.

platformEnv.about: Environment variables a runtime, a shell, a bundler (Vite: MODE, DEV, PROD, SSR, BASE_URL) or a hosting platform sets. Reading one is not a missing configuration key.

frameworkConfig.about: Configuration keys (or key prefixes ending in ':' or '.') a framework reads by itself, so code never names them. Not reported as config-unread.

nodeBuiltins.about: Node's own modules: an import of one of these is never a dependency. Also matched with a node: prefix.

pythonImportNames.about: A distribution whose import name differs from its package name. Without this an installed package reads as unused and its import as undeclared.
